$comment: TC-014 parameters (test plan §4.14). Written before any TC-014 measurement. Values the plan leaves to freeze time (q, repetitions, cache levels, waits) are set by the implementer and disclosed as deviation RK-DEV-02 (not witnessed).

q_ms.note: TC-001 calibration values were not available to this group; q is set here (RK-DEV-03)

verifier_matrix.real_pep: file-service PEP (SDK N, JWKS TTL 2000 ms, revocation push on), at tokens only
verifier_matrix.control_unpinned: two extra in-process at verifiers (TTL 1000 ms, push on) WITHOUT the JWKS server identity pin, used only in the fake-JWKS phase to show that the attack reaches the cache when the pin is absent; not part of the pass criteria

planned_rotation.comment: prepublish wait = max JWKS cache TTL (15 s) + 2 s; the retiring key of the previous cycle is removed in the next cycle (>= 17 s after it stopped signing, internal token TTL 10 s)

retain_and_removal.mistaken_removal: one removal of a retiring key with live tokens with the in-use check switched off (orchestrator misconfiguration, Azure AD 2021 type), observed 20 s

variants.what: attacker-signed tokens carrying jwk / jku / x5u / x5c header parameters (in-process verifiers and the real PEP)
JWKS address redirected to an attacker server presenting a certificate of the sandbox.test CA (untrusted CA)
JWKS address redirected to an attacker server presenting a valid SVID of another workload of the same CA (tool-service), JWKS with an attacker key under a new kid
as F3, but the attacker JWKS re-uses the currently active legitimate kid with the attacker key (kid collision)

jwks_outage.steps: prepublish next key, wait 17 s, block JWKS fetch (redirector blackhole), activate next key during the outage, emergency-revoke the previous key during the outage, restore

record_only: emergency revocation time from declaration to last acceptance per verification point (p50, p99, max; R-189.5 TBD)
JWKS outage: continued acceptance with last known good, rejection of the revoked kid during the outage
mistaken removal: verification failures caused and whether any detection signal was raised

definitions.epoch_applied: in-process push verifiers: first time the harness revocation client reports the kid as revoked; real PEP: time of its first rejection with detail kid_revoked in pep/file-service-enforce.jsonl
definitions.old_kid_accepted_after_epoch_applied: acceptance of a token with the revoked kid whose verification started after epoch_applied of that verification point
definitions.verification_failure: rejection of a token signed with the currently active key (in-process verifiers, real PEP) or a non-2xx answer to the authorized user's file.read / file.write during the planned-rotation phase
definitions.fake_jwks_accepted: acceptance of an attacker-signed token by any pinned in-process verifier or by the real PEP in F1-F4
definitions.issuance_error: non-2xx answer to the authorized user's traffic or a failed STS signing while the key-age hard limit is active

abort.C-3: baseline (before any key operation) or post-check: an acceptance-expected token rejected by any verification point, or a user-traffic failure. Upper limit 0
